page_title: ATA 2-0 TOR | Atalanta v Torino 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+5' 2 - 0 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from close in that easily beats the keeper. That makes it 2:0.
90+4' The resulting corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) comes to nothing.
90+2' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle as Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
87' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) gets a nice pass from Guillermo Maripan on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post.
87' Yunus Musah (Atalanta) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
86' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Zakaria Aboukhlal and he is replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
85' Substitution. Valentino Lazaro did his best and is replaced by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino).
85' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) and Gianluca Scamacca attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
84' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) launches a cross from the corner, but Alberto Paleari is alert to thwart the effort.

84' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Lazar Samardzic in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
82' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
80' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replaces Nicola Zalewski.
79' Charles De Ketelaere goes off the pitch and Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) comes on.
79' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

76' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
76' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

75' Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a great save to deny Giovanni Simeone (Torino) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
71' Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
70' Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

69' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Guillermo Maripan (Torino) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the right side of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
69' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
69' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Torino earn a corner.
69' Total attempts – 14:7. The shots on goal statistics – 4:1.
67' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Giorgio Scalvini is replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
67' Here's the change. Nikola Krstovic leaves the pitch and Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.

66' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Giovanni Simeone (Torino). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Giovanni Simeone (Torino) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
66' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) tries to find Nikola Krstovic, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
65' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
64' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Torino.
63' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
62' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
62' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) is penalised for holding. Francesco Fourneau signals a set piece.
60' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
59' Giovanni Simeone passes to Che Adams (Torino), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
57' A substitution has been made. Cyril Ngonge is replaced by Che Adams (Torino).
57' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) replacing Adrien Tameze.
57' Substitution. Giovanni Simeone (Torino) has come on for Duvan Zapata.
56' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is able to continue to play.
56' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) is caught offside yet again.
55' The game is interrupted now, Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Duvan Zapata (Torino) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
52' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Alberto Paleari comes off his line to gather the ball.
51' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
49' Post! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
48' Charles De Ketelaere sprays a pass out to Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the right post.
46' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a long ball in, but Marco Carnesecchi comfortably gathers the ball.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
45+1' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Marco Carnesecchi makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Duvan Zapata (Torino) after a cross from the side.
44' Problems for Raffaele Palladino as Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Isak Hien replaces him.
42' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
40' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta).
37' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is repeatedly being caught offside.

35' Alberto Paleari pulls off a great save to deny Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
34' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
33' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul after Saul Coco (Torino) hacks down one of his opponents. Atalanta have a free kick from a promising distance.

32' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball low towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Marco Carnesecchi with a fabulous save.
32' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) will deliver the corner kick.
32' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) releases Nikola Krstovic with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:1. 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
31' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
28' Alberto Paleari leaps to intercept the corner kick from Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta).

26' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper dives to his right to save the attempt which was aimed towards the underside of the crossbar. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adrien Tameze (Torino) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alberto Paleari reads it well and gathers the ball.

23' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
23' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) will take a corner kick.

23' A cross is whipped into the box by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) and Honest Ahanor controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
21' A pass lands at the feet of Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
20' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
18' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
16' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 56:44.
14' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle and it's Cyril Ngonge (Torino) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
13' 1 - 0 Lorenzo Bernasconi takes the corner and Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
12' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

12' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta). The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' A cross by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
11' That's unlucky! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
10' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) tries to find Charles De Ketelaere, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
9' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) attempts to release Nikola Krstovic with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
9' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
6' A crossfield pass from Adrien Tameze (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates.
4' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francesco Fourneau.
